title: Biological Control
definition: Biological control (Biocontrol) is a method of controlling pests, weeds, and plant diseases using other living organisms (natural enemies) such as predators, parasitoids, or pathogens. It is a cornerstone of Integrated Pest Management (IPM) aimed at reducing reliance on synthetic chemical pesticides.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Environment (GS-III) and Agriculture (GS-III). UPSC frequently tests the ecological balance, invasive species management, and the shift from chemical to sustainable agriculture.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Biological Control.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
